programme.title: Flikken Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: Wolfs is on the run because he is being sought for help with the escape of his daughter Fleur. He comes to the shocking discovery that Eva disappeared Jens Bols while guarding the public prosecutor. At the Safe House, Wolfs has a confrontation with BOLS. Wolfs manages to escape and starts, hunted by his own colleagues, a search for Eva. Romeo becomes a contact person for a returned Syria goer. / Wolfs is voortvluchtig omdat hij wordt gezocht voor de hulp bij het ontsnappen van zijn dochter Fleur. Hij komt tot de schokkende ontdekking dat Eva tijdens het bewaken van officier van justitie Jens Bols is verdwenen. Bij het safe house heeft Wolfs een confrontatie met Bols. Wolfs weet te ontsnappen en begint, opgejaagd door zijn eigen collegas, een zoektocht naar Eva. Romeo wordt contactpersoon voor een teruggekeerde Syriëganger.

programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom has been dreaming of a road trip along the iconic Karakoram Highway in Pakistan for years. A journey that Tom has been discouraged several times because of all kinds of terror and war threats. But now, after more than 10 years of traveling Waes, the time has come. Tom travels along the mountain tops of the Karakoram Mountains and discovers a breathtaking landscape at dizzying heights. / Al jaren droomt Tom van een road trip langs de iconische Karakoram Highway in Pakistan. Een reis die Tom al meermaals werd afgeraden omwille van allerlei terreur- en oorlogsdreigingen. Maar nu, na meer dan 10 jaar Reizen Waes, is het zover. Tom reist langs de bergtoppen van het Karakoramgebergte en ontdekt een adembenemend landschap op duizelingwekkende hoogtes.

programme.title: About food / Over eten
programme.desc: Cod and salmon are the most popular fish on our plate. But just like 90% of the fish we eat, they are imported. With that we are grossly overlooked surprisingly and surprisingly tasty fish from our North Sea. Kobe and Danira find out what we catch from the North Sea, how healthy fish is from a polluted sea, and how we can get more fish from our own sea in the future. Kobe walks along in the wake of radio presenter and happy Eeter Rani de Coninck. / Kabeljauw en zalm zijn met stip de populairste vissen op ons bord. Maar net als 90% van de vis die we eten, zijn ze geïmporteerd. Daarmee zien we verrassend veel en verrassend lekkere vis uit onze Noordzee schromelijk over het hoofd. Kobe en Danira zoeken uit wat we uit de Noordzee vangen, hoe gezond vis uit een vervuilde zee is, en hoe we in de toekomst meer vis uit eigen zee kunnen halen. Kobe loopt mee in het kielzog van radiopresentatrice en blije eter Rani De Coninck.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: I'm Jackie Onassis / Ja sam Jackie Onassis
programme.desc: Studying the character of a woman who lived a tragedy before the public's eyes and began again, a documentary explores the legacy that goes beyond her role as the president's wife and widow, and presents her as one of the most important cultural icons in American history. Entering the Consciousness of Americans as a glamorous first lady who brought youth, culture and elegance into the White House, Jacqueline Bouvier Kennedy Onassis became the obsession of the media after assassination of her husband and the embodiment of the sorrow of America. Escaping into the privacy of Onassis's property in Greece, she eventually returned to New York and became a literary editor, and established control of her own life, finally leaving the shadow of the powerful. programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.desc: This is a story of murder, plot, blood and secrets, but above all for love - an impossible love between two young, Aurora Taviani and Alessandro Montfort. The onion killer and the relationship between the hostile families - Taviani and Montfort. The effect develops amid the great vineyards of the picturesque province of Tuscany. / Това е една история за убийство, заговор, кръв и тайни, но преди всичко за любов - една невъзможна любов между двама млади, Аурора Тавиани и Алесандро Монфорте.Аурора Тавиани, несправедливо обвинена в убийството на Лука Монфорте, е освободена от затвора след 8-годишна присъда и се прибира в къщата на баба си.... В центъра на събития са бившият приятел на Аурора и неговите братя, майка й, истинската убийца на Лука и отношенията между враждебните фамилии - Тавиани и Монфорте.Действието се развива на фона на великите лозя на живописната провинция Тоскана.

programme.title: Dulum of land / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: DULUM Earth - (S03, E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Diana Prpić Šeketa from Brežan near Karlovac is a young farmer who successfully balances business and private life. Through the episode, viewers follow Diana run the ecological economy, growing strawberries, batatas and other crops, while in parallel cares for her little daughter Cviti and wife Anđelka. In addition to business challenges, Diana also faces motherhood - in the middle of the episode of Raja Rok, which gives her life a new dynamics. In addition to her husband, Anđelka, who helps her jugging her business obligations and family life, Diana successfully leads her agriculture, develops innovative practices such as the use of mycorized Batata transplants and promotes organic agriculture through social networks. The episode explores Diana's dedication to sustainability, the challenges he faces as a young farmer and her influence on the domestic market and the wider community. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Dulum zemlje - (S03, E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Diana Prpić Šeketa iz Brežana pokraj Karlovca mlada je poljoprivrednica koja uspješno balansira poslovni i privatni život. Kroz epizodu gledatelji prate kako Diana vodi ekološko gospodarstvo, uzgajajući jagode, batate i druge usjeve, dok paralelno brine o svojoj maloj kćeri Cviti i suprugu Anđelku. Osim poslovnih izazova, Diana se suočava i s majčinstvom - u sredini epizode rađa sina Roka, čime njezin život dobiva novu dinamiku. Uz supruga Anđelka, koji joj pomaže žonglirati poslovne obveze i obiteljski život, Diana uspješno vodi svoju poljoprivredu, razvija inovativne prakse poput korištenja mikoriziranih presadnica batata te putem društvenih mreža promovira ekološku poljoprivredu. Epizoda istražuje Dianinu posvećenost održivosti, izazove s kojima se suočava kao mlada poljoprivrednica te njezin utjecaj na domaće tržište i širu zajednicu. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E05, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) Chef David Skoko takes us to an exciting gastronomic journey with its companion, a red retro cooking. The dynamics of the modern life is fast, which means we don't always have the opportunity for long meals, so we will sometimes eat on the road. Street food or Street Food has become part of the vital culinary scene. But we often identify it with US or Asian cuisine. Can we also inspire street food? David travels by its beautiful and visits their friends, also some of our most important and most creative chefs, so together forces, with a lot of fun, tearing out the possibilities of local foods and seek recipes for our homemade street food. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Chef David Skoko vodi nas na uzbudljivo gastronomsko putovanje sa svojim suputnikom, crvenim retro kombijem za kuhanje. Dinamika suvremenoga života je brza, što znači da nemamo uvijek mogućnost za duge obroke pa ćemo ponekad i jesti na cesti. Ulična hrana ili street food postala je dio vitalne kulinarske scene. No često je poistovjećujemo samo s američkom ili azijskom kuhinjom. Možemo li se i mi inspirirati uličnom hranom? David putuje Lijepom Našom i posjećuje svoje prijatelje, ujedno neke od naših najvažnijih i najkreativnijih chefova, pa zajednički snagama, uz puno zabave, otkivaju mogućnosti lokalnih namirnica i traže recepte za našu domaću uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E10, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a showcase. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E10, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E19, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E19, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Western Cape - African Paradise Garden / Western Cape - Afrički rajski vrt
programme.desc: Western Cape - Africas Gardan Eden - (Doc. Film, Germany, 2023) Discover the beauty, diversity and uniqueness of the South African region of the Western Cape and its inhabitants. We meet Lindy and her boyfriend Franz who organize workshops on the preparation of lasagna and marine algae compounds. Let's take a breath with James through the Algi Forests in search of a completely new world, full of sharks, seals and various wild animals. Grandpa shows us a prison cell of Nelson Mandela on Robben Island. They were neighbors and became friends. Diethelm leads a boarding house with special care for its workers. One of them is Felix. He lives in a small house with four families. Roland is a successful e-bicycle pioneer. They are all connected by admiration and love for that wonderful part of the world. We gain insight into their lives and participate in a unique path across the Western Cape. R .: Andreas Knuffmann ... / Western Cape - Afrikas Garten Eden - (dok. film, Njemačka, 2023) Otkrijte ljepotu, raznolikost i jedinstvenost južnoafričkog predjela Zapadnog rta i njegovih stanovnika. Upoznajemo Lindy i njezina dečka Franza koji organiziraju radionice o spravljanju lazanja i složenaca od morskih algi. Ronimo na dah s Jamesom kroz šume algi u potrazi za posve novim svijetom, punim morskih pasa, tuljana i raznih divljih životinja. Dede nam pokazuje zatvorsku ćeliju Nelsona Mandele na otoku Robbenu. Bili su susjedi i postali su prijatelji. Diethelm vodi pansion uz posebnu brigu za svoje radnike. Jedan od njih je Felix. Živi u maloj kući s četiri obitelji. Roland je uspješan pionir e-bicikla. Sve ih povezuje divljenje i ljubav prema tom čudesnom dijelu svijeta. Stječemo uvid u njihov život i sudjelujemo u jedinstvenom putu preko Zapadnog rta. R.: Andreas Knuffmann...

programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E19, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E10, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a showcase. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to the horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E10, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E20, featured series, Spain) in 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of La Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E20, featured series, Spain) in 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of La Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conde Ul .... / La promesa - (S04, E20, igrana serija, Španjolska) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Conde Ul....

programme.title: Big stories, little people / Velike priče, mali ljudi
programme.desc: Great stories, little people - (E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) Tajana is a life like a movie story. And not any, but he told in the movie Coda, award -winning Oscars. Tajana is the only audible person in her family. He works as a translator at the Zagreb Association of deaf -blinds and without it the users of the association do not function. They do not see or hear, but they create amazing works of art. Tajana prepares an exhibition of users of the Association. We get acquainted with Kiki, painter, and the heat brothers, sculptors, who, although they do not see or hear, prepare their incredible works for the upcoming exhibition. A layered story of a meaningful life, a handicap, creativity and incredible talents. R.: Nancy Profaca ... / Velike priče, mali ljudi - (E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Tajanin je život poput filmske priče. I to ne bilo kakve, već on ispričane u filmu Coda, nagrađenom Oscarima. Tajana je jedina čujuća osoba u svojoj obitelji. Radi kao prevoditeljica u zagrebačkoj udruzi gluhoslijepih i bez nje korisnici udruge ne funkcioniraju. Oni ne vide i ne čuju, ali zato stvaraju nevjerojatna umjetnička djela. Tajana priprema izložbu korisnika Udruge. Upoznajemo se s Kikijem, slikarom, i braćom Vrućina, kiparima, koji iako ne vide i ne čuju, spremaju svoje nevjerojatne radove za nadolazeću izložbu. Slojevita priča o smislenom životu, hendikepu, kreativnosti i nevjerojatnim talentima. R.: Nensi Profaca...

programme.title: The paths of Frankopan / Putovima Frankopana
programme.desc: Frankopan Roads - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2025) The Frankopan family from the 12th to 17th centuries had a great influence on the political, economic and cultural life of Croatia. Reconstruction, preservation, protection and sustainable use of Frankopan material and intangible heritage are the goals of the project cultural and tourist route to Frankopan, which has launched the Primorje-Gorski Kotar County in 2017. What is the challenges of the renovation of the facilities that have lost its purpose because the world in which they have arisen has completely changed? It is the theme of the documentary film by Frankopan paths. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Putovima Frankopana - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Obitelj Frankopan je od 12. do 17. stoljeća imala veliki utjecaj na politički, gospodarski i kulturni život Hrvatske. Obnova, očuvanje, zaštita i održivo korištenje frankopanske materijalne i nematerijalne baštine ciljevi su projekta Kulturno-turistička ruta Putovima Frankopana koji je Primorsko-goranska županija pokrenula 2017. Koji je smisao i koji su izazovi obnove objekata koji su izgubili svoju svrhu jer se svijet u kojemu su nastali potpuno promijenio? Tema je to dokumentarnog filma Putovima Frankopana. R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.title: Gatori / Gatori
programme.desc: Gatori - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2024) Gators have been digging in Baranja for centuries. The spaces dug in the hill, without construction material, only dug the soil with the hard time and the effort of the digs. One of them, Denis Miklendin, probably the last one we found in Baranja. He learned the job from his father and is the fourth generation of the Gator digger. Gator digging is a craft that is slowly extinct. But because of the increasing interest in Baranja as a tourist destination and increasing demand for the renovation of the old Gator, the craft becomes sought after. Whether new or renewing old gamers are digging, it is a difficult and challenging job. It can also occur during digging because it is a naked land that is from the hill. Gators are used to store wine. They have a constant temperature of 14 degrees. At that temperature, the wine matures and is stored. We also get to know the young Philip of Golub, who is already a sixth generation of winemakers who produce wine in their centuries -old gator. R .: Sasa Uranjek ... / Gatori - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Gatori se u Baranji kopaju stoljećima. Prostori iskopani u brdu, bez građevnog materijala, samo iskopana zemlja mukom i trudom kopača. Jednog od njih, Denisa Miklendina, vjerojatno posljednjeg, pronašli smo u Baranji. On je posao naučio od svog oca i četvrta je generacija kopača gatora. Kopanje gatora zanat je koji polako izumire. No, zbog sve većeg interesa za Baranju kao turističku destinaciju i sve veće potražnje za obnovom starih gatora, zanat ponovno postaje tražen. Neovisno kopaju li se novi ili obnavljaju stari gatori, težak je to i izazovan posao. Može doći i do urušavanja tijekom kopanja jer je riječ o goloj zemlji koja se iznosi iz brda. Gatori služe za čuvanje vina. U njima je stalna temperatura od 14 stupnjeva. Na toj temperaturi vino zrije i čuva se. Upoznajemo i mladog Filipa Golubova, koji je već šesta generacija vinara koja u svom stoljetnom gatoru tradicionalnim načinom proizvodi vino. R.: Saša Uranjek...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E06, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) In the sixth episode David Skoko travels to the mystical damn garden, Hortus Diabolicus, as the earlier records called Gorski Kotar. He travels to a visit to the close friend Igor Gudcu, a chef who says it is first a caterer, because she first finds guests, and only then the chef. Igor is an amazing culinary creative that proves every new project. David and Igor will try to connect the principles of street food with Goranian foods and tradition. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) U šestoj epizodi David Skoko putuje u mistični vražji vrt, Hortus diabolicus, kako se u najranijim zapisima nazivao Gorski kotar. Putuje u posjet bliskome prijatelju Igoru Gudcu, chefu koji za sebe kaže da je prvo ugostitelj, jer u prvome redu voli goste, a tek onda i kuhar. Igor je nevjerojatan kulinarski kreativac što dokazuje svakim novim projektom. David i Igor pokušat će povezati načela ulične hrane s goranskim namirnicama i tradicijom. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Rijeka stories / Riječke priče
programme.desc: Rijeka stories - (E01, travelogue series, Croatia, 2020) This is a story of the early history of Rijeka, from Roman Trsatika to a small medieval city that follows the drawn urban contours of the ancient settlement. What are the valuable architectural monuments preserved from this period and what is left of structures from that time? The story is also about the beginning of the industry in Rijeka through the establishment of a sugar factory and the ambitions of the Habsburgs to make Rijeka an important industrial center and an important bow. These segments of Rijeka history, through short lines, speaks historians, conservators and chroniclers of Rijeka's industrial heritage. R .: Ivica Dlesk ... / Riječke priče - (E01, putopisna serija, Hrvatska, 2020) Ovo je priča o ranoj povijesti Rijeke, od rimske Trsatike do malog srednjovjekovnog grada koji prati ucrtane urbanističke konture antičkog naselja. Koji su vrijedni arhitektonski spomenici sačuvani iz tog razdoblja i što je ostalo od struktura iz toga vremena? Priča je to i o početku industrije u Rijeci kroz osnivanje tvornice šećera i o ambicijama Habsburgovaca da Rijeku učine važnim industrijskim središtem i važnom lukom. O tim segmentima riječke povijesti, kroz kratke crtice govore povjesničari, konzervatori i kroničari riječke industrijske baštine. R.: Ivica Dlesk...

programme.title: Tandem / Tandem
programme.desc: Tandem - (S04, E12, feature series, France, 2020) Antonin, one of Paul's best friends one night calls him completely panicked. His wife Cyrielle disappeared and Antonin is convinced that he intended to throw himself off the bridge. When Paul arrives at the foot of the bridge, he saw Cyrielle falling. It throws into the water, but it arrives too late and fails to save it. The gendarmes expect the case quickly to be concluded because it is a suicide to which Paul testified. But Lea wonders why Antonin called Paula instead of an emergency service, which was closer to the bridge. Did Antonin use Paul to portray Cyrielle's murder as suicide? Nestala je njegova žena Cyrielle i Antonin je uvjeren da se kani baciti s mosta. Kad Paul stiže u podnožje mosta, ugleda Cyrielle kako pada. Baca se u vodu, ali stiže prekasno i ne uspijeva je spasiti. Žandari očekuju da će slučaj brzo biti zaključen jer je riječ o samoubojstvu kojem je svjedočio Paul. Ali Lea se pita zašto je Antonin nazvao Paula umjesto hitne službe, koja je bila bliže mostu. Je li Antonin iskoristio Paula da Cyrielleino ubojstvo prikaže kao samoubojstvo? R.: Lionel Chatton Ul.: Astrid Veillon (Lea Soler), Stephane Blancafort (Paul Marchal), Alexandre Varga (Antonin Vallette), Pierick Tournier (Erwan Lebellec), Baya Rehaz (Inès Zaïdi)...

programme.title: Crack / Pukotina
programme.desc: Breach - (thriller, USA, 2007) Spy thriller, inspired by real events in the FBI and guardians of the most sensitive and potentially most dangerous US secrets. The young Eric Oneill has finally been improved and starts working at the FBI headquarters. His dream of becoming a real agent just didn't come true. He starts working with a renowned operative Robert Hansesen to ensure information, a new department created to protect all confidential information. But Oneill soon reveals the real reason why they hired him. Hansen is the only suspect in a long -term, strictest guarded investigation. He is even more dangerous because of the huge amount of data entrusted to him. The FBI asks Onell to take advantage of the fact that Hansen is increasingly trusting him. He must not arouse any doubt. Oneill has to manage in a killer game against another spy, and cannot be relying on any help. He must destroy Hansesen before a double spy and a traitor destroy him, his family and a nation that they should both protect. No od te glasne glazbe tresu se žice, pa Kyan i Blatko gube ravnotežu, a vidikovac se olabavi i ugrozi turiste. Hoće li Kyan uspjeti doći na drugu stranu i hoće li Go Jetteri spasiti turiste? Ovo je pustolovina visoke napetosti - nemojte gledati dolje! R.: Robert Cullen Ul.: John Hasler (Foz), Tommie Earl Jenkins (Ubercorn), Akie Kotabe (Kyan), Syrus Lowe (Lars), Naomi McDonald (Jetpad)...

programme.title: My India / Moja Indija
programme.desc: My India - (E04, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2003) We show 6 episodes of travel series about India by director Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric (1950 - 2024). The series is investigating Haridwar and Rishikesh, a pilgrimage town of Hinduist and a center of yoga in India, located next to the clear Ganges. Many come to Rishikesh today from all over the world, seeking peace and harmony. We also take you to the province of Rajestan, to the city of Pushkar, to the Festival and the Deva Fair and Jaipur, which is popularly called "Pink City" because of the facades colored in pink. We also get to know Varanas, the most holy city in India, 2000 years old. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Moja Indija - (E04, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2003) Prikazujemo 6 epizoda putopisne serije o Indiji redateljice Ljubice Janković Lazarić (1950. - 2024.). Serija istražuje Haridwar i Rishikesh, hodočasničko mjesto hinduista i centar joge u Indiji, smješteno uz bistri Ganges. U Rishikesh danas dolaze mnogi sa svih strana svijeta tražeći mir i harmoniju. Vodimo vas i u pokrajinu Rajestan, u grad Pushkar, na festival i sajam deva te Jaipur koji se popularno naziva "Pink City" zbog fasada obojenih u ružičasto. Upoznajemo i Varanasi, najsvetiji grad u Indiji, star 2000 godina. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Wetlands and life in them / Močvarna staništa i život u njima
programme.desc: Wetlands of habitats and life in them - (E01, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) Wetlands belong to the most productive ecosystems in the world, along with rain forests and coral reefs. Kopački rit is one of the most important floods in Europe. The value of the Kopački rit Nature Park was confirmed in 1993 by its inclusion on the list of wet areas of international importance, especially as the habitats of the swamp birds, according to the Ramsar Convention, ie the Convention on Wet Areas. R .: Dominik Zen ... / Močvarna staništa i život u njima - (E01, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Močvarna staništa pripadaju najproduktivnijim ekosustavima na svijetu, zajedno s kišnim šumama i koraljnim grebenima. Kopački rit je jedno od najvažnijih poplavnih područja u Europi. Vrijednost Parka prirode Kopački rit potvrđena je 1993. godine njegovim uvrštavanjem na popis vlažnih područja od međunarodne važnosti, osobito kao staništa ptica močvarica, prema Ramsarskoj konvenciji, odnosno Konvenciji o vlažnim područjima. R.: Dominik Zen...

Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: 69. Split Summer / 69. Splitsko ljeto
programme.desc: 69. Split Summer - (entertainment program, Croatia, 2023) to the 69th anniversary of the important festival of opera, drama, music and dance whose ceremonial opening on July 14, 2023. Traditionally transmitted by Croatian Television, we bring the performance of one of the most performed works of the World Opera Literature - Opera of Tosco by Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi. Libreta was written by Luigi Ilica and Giuseppe Giacos according to the drama "La Tosca" Victorienna Sardou. Under the direction of Maestro Ivo Lipanovic and directed by Goran Golovk, a real love - political thriller focused on the relations between the protagonists (Tosca, Cavadossi, Scarpia) awaits us on Peristyle. The shop takes place in Rome, afternoon and evening on June 14 and early in the morning of June 15, 1800. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / 69. Splitsko ljeto - (zabavni program, Hrvatska, 2023) Na 69. obljetnicu važnog festivala opere, drame, glazbe i plesa čije je svečano otvorenje 14. srpnja 2023. tradicionalno prenosila Hrvatska televizija, donosimo izvedbu jednog od najizvođenijih djela svjetske operne literature - operu Tosca talijanskog skladatelja Giuseppea Verdija. Libreto su napisali Luigi Ilica i Giuseppe Giacosa prema drami " La Tosca" Victoriena Sardoua. Pod ravnanjem maestra Ive Lipanovića i u režiji Gorana Golovka, na Peristilu nas čeka pravi ljubavno - politički triler usredotočen na odnose protagonista (Tosca, Cavaradossi, Scarpia). Radnja se odvija u Rimu, poslijepodne i navečer 14. lipnja te rano ujutro 15. lipnja 1800. Operu prenosimo s hrvatskim titlovima! R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Sea, island and four sculptors / More, otok i četiri kipara
programme.desc: Sea, island and four sculptors - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2012) Documentary film about 4 Croatian sculptures (Kuzma Kovacic, Slavomir Drinkovic, Kazimir Hraste and Perusko Bogdanic) originally from Hvar is the story of four exceptional artistic personalities that have characterized contemporary art in Croatia with their artistic creation. Through the intimate stories of the sculptors themselves, recorded in the environment where they were born and grew up, the film speaks to Hvar cultural, historical and ambient influence on their biological, spiritual and artistic maturation. The starting point was set out by a dedication to their first group exhibition held in the Old Town of Hvar, which is what the organizers - prominent art historians speak. R .: Ivica Dlesk ... / More, otok i četiri kipara - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2012) Dokumentarni film o 4 hrvatska kipara (Kuzma Kovačić, Slavomir Drinković, Kažimir Hraste i Peruško Bogdanić) porijeklom s Hvara priča je o četiri izuzetne umjetničke osobnosti koje su svojim umjetničkim stvaralaštvom obilježile suvremenu umjetnost u Hrvatskoj. Kroz intimne priče samih kipara, snimljenih u ambijentu gdje su rođeni i odrastali, film govori hvarskom kulturnom, povijesnom i ambijentalnom utjecaju na njihovo biološko, duhovno i umjetničko sazrijevanje. Kao polazna točka postavljena je svojevrsna posveta njihovoj prvoj skupnoj izložbi održanoj u Starom Gradu na Hvaru, o kojoj govore organizatori - istaknuti povjesničari umjetnosti. R.: Ivica Dlesk...

programme.title: The sunny side of Prisavlje / Sunčana strana Prisavlja
programme.desc: Sunny side of Prisavlje - (Music. Video Witness, Croatia, 2020) The band Jonathan are five close friends from Rijeka who in November 2013 The single "Maggie" win the Croatian music scene. The awards of music professionals and audiences receive the premiere of the debut album "Bliss" in May next year. The beginning of their career is characterized by a calendar full of concerts in clubs and festivals. They hold concerts in their native Rijeka and in Zagreb, where they perform as a pre -band to the cult editors, which they later join on a part of the European tour. After the success of the 2015 debut album. In the same year, they were nominated for the Porin Music Award in the category of the new performer of the year. 2018 releases the conceptual double album "To Love" + "To Hold", which achieve success in the domestic and foreign music scene. Often compared to the famous names of the Indie Rock world, such as Franz Ferdinand, Editors, Interpol, Placeb or The Strokes, Jonathan gains his popularity at concerts through clubs across Croatia. The album is accompanied by performances at the most important festivals of the region such as the INmusic, Flow Festival and the Exit Festival, where they played as a pre -band to the greats of The Killers. In March 2019, it is the first one-month tour across the US, which consists of 15 concerts, including performances at the SXSW Festival in Austin and the Colossus Festival in New York. R.: Vesna Fijac Fodor ... / Sunčana strana Prisavlja - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska, 2020) Bend Jonathan su petorica bliskih prijatelja iz Rijeke koji u studenom 2013. singlom "Maggie" osvajaju hrvatsku glazbenu scenu. Priznanja glazbenih profesionalaca i publike dobivaju premijerom debitantskog albuma "Bliss" u svibnju sljedeće godine. Početak njihove karijere obilježava kalendar pun koncerata u klubovima i festivalima. Održavaju koncerte u rodnoj Rijeci te u Zagrebu gdje nastupaju kao predgrupa kultnim Editorsima, kojima se kasnije pridružuju na dijelu europske turneje. Nakon uspjeha debitantskog albuma 2015. objavljuju EP "Getting Closer Is Keeping Us Apart". Iste godine nominirani su za glazbenu nagradu Porin u kategoriji Novi izvođač godine. 2018. objavljuju konceptualni dvostruki album "To Love" + "To Hold" kojim postižu uspjeh na domaćoj i inozemnoj glazbenoj sceni. Često u usporedbi s poznatim imenima iz indie rock svijeta, poput Franza Ferdinanda, Editorsa, Interpola, Placeba ili The Strokesa, Jonathan svoju popularnost stječe na koncertima po klubovima diljem Hrvatske. Album prate nastupi na najvažnijim festivalima regije kao što su INmusic, Flow Festival i Exit Festival gdje su svirali kao predgrupa velikanima The Killers. U ožujku 2019. je prva jednomjesečnu turneju diljem SAD-a koja se sastoji od 15 koncerata uključujući nastupe na SXSW festivalu u Austinu te Colossus festivalu u New Yorku. R.: Vesna Fijačko Fodor...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) Labyrinth - a mystical word that invokes ancient stories from antiquity. But the labirins are much older than that. We will hardly ever be able to fully understand the motives of our ancestors from the Stone Age that engraved them in the rock 15,000 years ago. Petroglyphs with maze of labinates were found from Neolithic to Bronze Age (from 6000 to 3800 years ago) on megalithic graves or rocks in England, Ireland, Norway, Sweden, Spain and Italy. They continued their lives in antiquity and in Gothic cathedrals. We can say that these are holy, archetypal patterns of different shapes and sizes, mostly with seven or more paths that wind, but they all have one way to the center. So, they say some, they have not served, nor do they serve today, so that a man will lose themselves in them, but on the contrary - to find himself ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Labirint - mistična riječ koja priziva drevne priče iz antike. No, labirinti su puno stariji od toga. Teško da ćemo ikada u potpunosti moći razumjeti motive naših predaka iz kamenog doba koji su ih urezivali u stijeni prije 15.000 godina. Petroglifi s motivom labirinata pronađeni su u razdoblju od neolitika do brončanog doba (od prije 6000 do prije 3800 godina) na megalitskim grobnicama ili stijenama u Engleskoj, Irskoj, Norveškoj, Švedskoj, Španjolskoj i Italiji. Nastavili su svoj život u antici i u gotičkim katedralama. Možemo reći da su to sveti, arhetipski uzorci različitih oblika i veličina, najčešće sa sedam ili više staza, koje vijugaju, no sve imaju jedan put do središta. Dakle, kažu neki, nisu služili, niti danas služe, da bi se čovjek u njima izgubio, već naprotiv - da bi se pronašao...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E07, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E07, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Serija predstavlja neke od najslavnijih arhitekata na svijetu. Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: Retrospective Alain Delona: Our story / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Naša priča
programme.desc: Notre Histoire - (Film Satir, France, 1984) Romantic drama with the farce elements, about a middle -aged man who leaves her husband and a lifestyle so far because of a beautiful strap stranger. Emotionally numb from the lifestyle of life, middle -aged Robert Avranche (Alain Delon) travels by train thinking what to do from his future. Although there are no material problems, Robert is becoming more and more dissatisfied with his marriage and family situation, so it seems to him that the solution is in the new romance. Suddenly his answer arrives in the form of a beautiful Donatienne (Nathalie Baye) companion, who openly seduces him in the train. In love with her femininity and determination, Robert embarks on a passionate relationship with a beautiful stranger. R .: Bertrand Blier Ul.: Alain Delon (Robert Avranche), Nathalie Baye (Geneviève Avranche / Marie-Harèse Chatelard / Donatienne Pouring), Michel Galabra (Emile Pecqueur), Sabine Haudepin (Carmen), Geneviève Fontanel ... Madeleine Pecqueur) ... / Notre histoire - (filmska satira, Francuska, 1984) Romantična drama s elementima farse, o sredovječnom muškarcu koji ostavlja suprugu i dotadašnji način života zbog lijepe neznanke iz vlaka. Emotivno otupio od dotadašnjeg načina života, sredovječni Robert Avranche (Alain Delon) putuje vlakom razmišljajući što učiniti od svoje budućnosti. Iako nema materijalnih problema, Robert je sve nezadovoljniji svojim brakom i obiteljskom situacijom, pa mu se učini da je rješenje u novoj romanci. Iznenada mu odgovor stigne u obliku lijepe suputnice Donatienne (Nathalie Baye) koja ga u kupeu vlaka otvoreno stane zavoditi. Zaluđen njezinom ženstvenošću i odlučnošću, Robert se upusti u strastvenu vezu s lijepom neznankom. R.: Bertrand Blier Ul.: Alain Delon (Robert Avranche), Nathalie Baye (Geneviève Avranche / Marie-Therèse Chatelard / Donatienne Pouget), Michel Galabru (Emile Pecqueur), Sabine Haudepin (Carmen), Geneviève Fontanel (Madeleine Pecqueur)...

programme.title: Generation y / Generacija Y
programme.desc: Generation Y - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2015) an integral element of everyday life, relationships with parents, friends, assumed, with agreement is disagreement. In such situations, people respond differently: some are cool while others are just not cool. What annoys the young people most, which is most arguing with and with whom, the theme of this episode of the generation of Y. R .: Tiha Gudac ... / Generacija Y - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2015) Sastavni element svakodnevnog života, odnosa s roditeljima, prijateljima, pretpostavljenima, uz slaganje je i neslaganje. U takvim situacijama ljudi različito reagiraju: neki su cool dok su drugi sve samo ne cool. Što mlade najviše živcira, oko čega se najviše svađaju i s kim, tema je ove epizode Generacije Y. R.: Tiha Gudac...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2013) It is almost certain that no Croatian band has received so much positive criticism for their debut album as them. From London, through New York, Ria, Hong Kong, Tokyo ... Everyone agrees that the Croatian rock group is one of the biggest surprises on the global scene. They have long prepared, well prepared and created a unique mix of heavy metal, punk and rockabilly with a basic rock sound. One critic wrote about their album: "Explodisiac Group Kevrina Bikini is something the best that has happened on the Croatian rock scene in recent years." A few months later, more precisely, in early 2013, they signed a contract with the British label Freaky Pug Pug PR and Records. Ben Hughes, a rock critic of influential British portal Uberrock.co.uk, concluded that Kevrno Bikini sounds like James Hetfield from Metallica singing in the System of A Down group. In the garage they play: Devils Jukebox, Hoax Revolution, Human Spittoon, Wow, Anti Rock Kevlar Bikini are: Matija Auker, Mario Berta, Vladimir Kasal and Vedran Ernjakovic ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2013) Gotovo je sigurno da niti jedan hrvatski bend nije dobio toliko pozitivnih kritika za svoj debi album kao oni. Od Londona, preko New Yorka, Ria, Hong Konga, Tokyja... svi se slažu da je hrvatska rock grupa jedno od najvećih iznenađenja na globalnoj sceni. Dugo su se spremali, dobro pripremili i stvorili jedinstvenu mješavinu heavy metala, punka i rockabillyja s bazičnim rock zvukom. Jedan kritičar je o njihovom albumu zapisao: "Explodisiac grupe Kevlar Bikini je nešto najbolje što se dogodilo na hrvatskoj rock sceni posljednjih puno godina." Nekoliko mjeseci poslije, točnije, početkom 2013., potpisali su ugovor s britanskom etiketom Freaky Pug PR and Records. Ben Hughes, rock kritičar utjecajnog britanskog portala Uberrock.co.uk zaključio je da Kevlar Bikini zvuči kao da James Hetfield iz Metallice pjeva u grupi System of a Down. U Garaži sviraju: Devils Jukebox, Hoax Revolution, Human Spittoon, Wow, Anti rock Kevlar Bikini su: Matija Auker, Mario Berta, Vladimir Kasal i Vedran Ernjaković...

Često u usporedbi s poznatim imenima iz indie rock svijeta, poput Franza Ferdinanda, Editorsa, Interpola, Placeba ili The Strokesa, Jonathan svoju popularnost stječe na koncertima po klubovima diljem Hrvatske. Album prate nastupi na najvažnijim festivalima regije kao što su INmusic, Flow Festival i Exit Festival gdje su svirali kao predgrupa velikanima The Killers. U ožujku 2019. je prva jednomjesečnu turneju diljem SAD-a koja se sastoji od 15 koncerata uključujući nastupe na SXSW festivalu u Austinu te Colossus festivalu u New Yorku. programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2011) The charismatic oeuvre of the Brkan brothers, two true greats of contemporary Croatian photographs, are the foundation of the so -called. Zadar schools of photography. Zvonimir Brkan (1920 - 1979), as well as his older brother Ante, has created almost all his anthological works today in Zadar, in the immediate vicinity of the family home. Although his work has a starting point in the current post -war photographic trends of neorealism and poetic realism, he quickly becomes self -sufficient, without a single extreme role model, but also without a single follower. programme.title: Half a century of disc / Pola stoljeća diska
programme.desc: Half a century Disk - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2015) Petar Ivulic, Split adventurer of Brac roots and Paris addresses, in 1964 in Jelsa on the island of Hvar, opened the first discoklub in the then country. It cannot register it under that name because such a thing does not exist as an option ... With this pioneering venture, a wave of opening of discoklubs across the country was launched and this form of social gathering was marked by the next two decades. But was Jelska's "Amphora" first? They have a different opinion at the Opatija Museum in Opatija. What makes one club a real discoklub? What was the importance of these places? Positive and negative effects on society? The movie answers these and many other questions. Filmed in Jelsa, Opatija, Rijeka, Split, Zagreb and Paris, with the help of about fifty interlocutors, illustrated with archival recordings, photographs and documents from that time and contemporary recordings of locations, revives the pioneering period of discor in Croatia. Husar, Amphora, Club 57, Arcada, Semafor, Saloon ... What did these names mean to us today? R.: Zvonimir Rumboldt Ul.: Ana Majhenic ... / Pola stoljeća diska - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2015) Petar Ivulić, splitski avanturist bračkih korijena a pariške adrese, godine 1964. u Jelsi na otoku Hvaru otvara prvi diskoklub u tadašnjoj državi. Ne može ga registrirati pod tim imenom jer takvo što ne postoji kao opcija... Tim pionirskim pothvatom pokrenut je val otvaranja diskoklubova diljem zemlje i taj oblik socijalnog druženja obilježio je sljedeće dvije dekade. No, je li baš jelšanska "Amfora" bila prva? U Muzeju turizma u Opatiji imaju drugačije mišljenje. Što to jedan klub čini pravim diskoklubom? Koja je bila važnost tih mjesta? Pozitivni i negativni učinci na društvo? Film odgovara na ta i mnoga druga pitanja. Sniman u Jelsi, Opatiji, Rijeci, Splitu, Zagrebu i Parizu, uz pomoć pedesetak sugovornika, ilustriran arhivskim snimkama, fotografijama i dokumentima iz tog vremena te suvremenim snimkama lokacija, oživljava pionirsko razdoblje diskogroznice u Hrvatskoj. Husar, Amfora, Club 57, Arkada, Semafor, Saloon... Što su ta imena značila onda i što nam govore danas? R.: Zvonimir Rumboldt Ul.: Ana Majhenić...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) This is the first broadcast of four of them, which is being covered by the multi -day program of the sixth edition of the Euphonie Festival in Warsaw, the Festival of Central European and Eastern European Music, which took place this year under the theme "Jeke and Srection". It brings a review of a magnificent concert performance of a summer opera star, the world's largest mezzo -soprano Elina Garanče, with the Orchestra of the Great Theater of the Polish National Opera and under the leadership of her life and professional partner Karel Marko Chichon. The "Opera Gala" concert in November 15 was held and, among other things, performed the rarity aria of Carmen, which Bizet originally wrote for his heroine, but the singers declared it impossible for her and replaced her with a famous Habaner. Although she is talked about in an interview with Garanca, we could not record her for banning her publisher. That is why, with the interviews, we housed her first performance of Julia's lullaby from the 3rd act of Dvořák's Opera "Jakobinac" op. 84 from 1888, with which she opened a spectacular concert, respecting the geographical framework of the festival. After the concert, the singer and conductor shared autographs in the foyer of the halls late into the night and took pictures with fans who were patiently waiting in an endless order. At the same time, it was an occasion for exclusively for Croatian television to announce their recent arrival in Zagreb on February 10, 2025, when they would perform in the "Best of Elina Garanca" program at the Lisinski Concert Hall, which they both look forward to because the previous two concerts in that hall, at the invitation of its former director Drazen Siriščević. Many of his participants in the auditorium are discussed about the Euphonie Festival and the Euphonie Festival: Olga Wysock, Director of the National Institute Adam Mickiewicz, in charge of promoting Polish art abroad; King Wojciechowska, owner and editor -in -chief of magazine and portal dedicated to music and art, Presto Publish, Mediac ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovo je prva emisija u nizu od četiri, koliko ih obrađuje višednevni program šestog izdanja Festivala Eufonie u Varšavi, festivala srednjoeuropske i istočnoeuropske glazbe, koji se ove godine odvio pod temom "Jeke i odzvanjanja". Donosi osvrt na veličanstven koncertni nastup letonske operne zvijezde, najveće svjetske mezzosopranistice Eline Garanče, uz Orkestar Velikog kazališta Poljske narodne opere i pod vodstvom njezina životnog i profesionalnog partnera Karela Marka Chichona. "Opera gala" koncert u održan je 15. studenog i na njemu su, među ostalim, izveli raritetnu ariju Carmen koju je Bizet izvorno napisao za svoju junakinju, ali su je pjevačice njegova doba proglasile neizvedivom pa ju je zamijenio poznatom habanerom. Premda se o njoj govori u intervjuu s Garančom, nismo je mogli snimiti zbog zabrane njezina izdavača. Zato smo uz intervjue smjestili njezinu prvu izvedbu Julijine uspavanke iz 3. čina Dvořákove opere "Jakobinac" op. 84. iz 1888., s kojim je otvorila spektakularni koncert, poštujući zemljopisni okvir festivala. Nakon koncerta, pjevačica i dirigent su u foajeu dvorane do kasno u noć dijelili autograme i fotografirali se s obožavateljima koji su strpljivo čekali u beskonačnom redu. Ujedno, bila je to prigoda da ekskluzivno za Hrvatsku televiziju najave svoj skorašnji dolazak u Zagreb 10. veljače 2025., kada će nastupiti u programu "Best of Elina Garanča" u Koncertnoj dvorani Lisinski, čemu se oboje jako raduju jer su im prethodna dva koncerta u toj dvorani, na poziv njezina nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Dražena Siriščevića, ostala u lijepom sjećanju. O programu koncerta te općenito o Festivalu Eufonie govore mnogi njegovi sudionici koje smo susreli u auditoriju: Olga Wysocka, ravnateljica nacionanog Instituta Adam Mickiewicz, zaduženog za promociju poljske umjetnosti u inozemstvu; Kinga Wojciechowska, vlasnica i glavna urednica časopisa i portala posvećenog glazbi i umjetnosti Presto Publishing, medijsk...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Instead of intrusiveness and technical dismay, in the music of one of the most versatile jazz -gitarist Bill Frisella there are calmness, beauty of tone and above all - music. She is so expressed with him that his music is not particularly interested in genre frames, and so is jazz in the narrow sense, the essence is simply put in the beauty of playing and it has an advantage over every kind of manner or restrictions. However, this does not mean that it is a root -free musician: with jazz, there are above all expressed earthen, folk elements of American traditions that pursue a large trough we can call American. Given this tendency, it is not surprising that Frisell is largely a musician of paint, space and sound scene. However, the same is unmistakably recognized in wider formats, from the breakthroughs in the bands of drummer and musical relative Paul Motian, with whom he will collaborate for four decades, to a variety of compositions in which Frisell continues to gather masters of unobtrusiveness, such as Joey Baron or Kenny Wollesen. If Frisell's "natural" habitat should be determined, these would probably be small compositions - duo, trio - where everything rests on the most welcome focus, listening and interaction. Triapal format is perhaps a solid frame of his bandlider action, starting with the baron on drums and Kermit Driscoll on the double bass, which would often be upgraded to other associates. In recent years, the key Frisell's music comrades of drummer Rudy Royston and the fantastic counter -bassist Thomas Morgan, with which he recorded a couple of exceptional duo albums. He also came to Rijeka with them, where he performed as part of the 33rd edition of the Jazztime Rijeka Festival, reminding us how much one can say when equal attention is left with the space between notes and musicians, as well as notes themselves ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjesto nametljivosti i tehničkog razmetanja, u glazbi jednog od najsvestranijih jazz-gitarista Billa Frisella tu su mirnoća, ljepota tona i prije svega - muzikalnost. Toliko je ona kod njega izražena da njegova glazba nije posebno zainteresirana za žanrovske okvire, pa tako ni jazz u užem smislu, bit je u jednostavno rečeno ljepoti sviranja i ona ima prednost pred svakom vrstom manire ili ograničenja. To međutim ne znači da je riječ o muzičaru bez korijena: uz jazz, tu su prije svega izraženi zemljani, narodni elementi američke tradicije koji se slijevaju u veliko korito koje možemo nazvati americanom. S obzirom na tu sklonost, ne čudi da je Frisell u velikoj mjeri glazbenik boje, prostora i zvučnog prizora. No isto se nepogrešivo prepoznaje i u širim formatima, od proboja u bendovima bubnjara i glazbenog srodnika Paula Motiana, s kojim će surađivati tijekom četiri desetljeća, pa do najrazličitijih sastava u kojima Frisell nastavlja okupljati majstore nenametljivosti, kao što su Joey Baron ili Kenny Wollesen. Ako bi se trebalo odrediti Frisellovo "prirodno" stanište, to bi vjerojatno bili mali sastavi - duo, trio - gdje sve počiva na najpažljivijem fokusu, slušanju i interakciji. Format trija je možda i čvrst okvir njegova bendliderskog djelovanja počevši s onim s Baronom na bubnjevima i Kermitom Driscollom na kontrabasu, koji bi se često i nadograđivao drugim suradnicima. Zadnjih su godina ključni Frisellovi muzički drugovi bubnjar Rudy Royston i fantastični kontrabasist Thomas Morgan, s kojim je snimio i par iznimnih duo albuma. S njima je došao i u Rijeku, gdje je nastupio u sklopu 33. izdanja festivala JazzTime Rijeka podsjetivši nas koliko se toga može reći kada se jednaka pažnja ostavlja prostoru između nota i muzičara, kao i notama samima...

programme.title: The painter of his country - Ivan Generalić / Slikar svoje zemlje - Ivan Generalić
programme.desc: The painter of his country - 100 years of Ivan Generalić - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2015) One of the most significant Croatian painters in the 20th century is undoubtedly Ivan Generalić (1914 - 1992). Moreover, this claim is shown to be accurate and in a wider context, namely, in the world fine arts, where his work also highly valued and emphasized criticism by authentic poetics and specific painting skills. In his life, Generalic was synonymous with Croatian naive art and had operated his small village of Hlebine in Pitomoj Podravina into an unavoidable address on the cultural map of Croatia. With this documentary film, his creativity is chronologically depicted and his originality and deep rooting in the traditional customs of the native village and the Podravina landscape emphasized. R .: Miljenko Bukovčan ... / Slikar svoje zemlje - 100 godina Ivana Generalića - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2015) Jedan od najznačajnijih hrvatskih slikara u 20. stoljeću nedvojbeno je Ivan Generalić (1914. - 1992.). Štoviše, ta se tvrdnja pokazuje točnom i u širem kontekstu, naime, i u svjetskoj likovnoj umjetnosti gdje je njegovo djelo također visoko vrednovala i apostrofirala kritika po autentičnoj poetici i specifičnom slikarskom umijeću. Još za svojega života Generalić je bio sinonim za hrvatsku naivnu umjetnost i svoje je maleno selo Hlebine u pitomoj Podravini prometnuo u nezaobilaznu adresu na kulturnoj karti Hrvatske. Ovim dokumentarnim filmom kronološki se prikazuje njegovo stvaralaštvo i naglašava njegova izvornost i duboka ukorijenjenost u tradicijske običaje rodnoga sela i podravski krajolik. R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2010) Ivan Mihaljević and Side Effects is a progressive rock sensation from Zagreb. After the first album of Sandcastle, who sludged the criticism of foreign journalists and after performing with many world guitar stars such as Paul Gilbert, Les Paul and Richie Kotzen, the guys were recorded by the second album title Destination Unknown. The story started as an independent project of guitarist Ivan Mihhaljevic (which is a guitarist of the Hard Time group, which I recorded his first album Sandcastle, and then he joined the other members in order to perform that material live. After a year, the band cooperation in which all members participate in the creative process, the Album Destination Unknown was taken. Along with MIHA in the role of guitarist and vocals, other members are Michael Jagunić on the bass guitar and Alen Frilla on drums. The Gang Bang Group is the author's band Rock orientation with the admixtures of Blues and Progressive. The Group is created in 2004. year, and in this composition since 2007. until 2009. Gang Bang on HRT recorded 11 demodes, and the Song Egocentric Blues produces Bahrija Golubović. At that time, in the Studio, Bajsić in the holy recorded and one of the significant live works. The group is then formed: Ivan Pelivanović - Pele (Guitar), Nikola Kufrin (Karlo Kurtalj (Bas-Guitar), which Ivan Pelivanović is taking over the main authority since he had already had good results in writing theater music (County Prize For the best theater music in 2007. For the show Petar Pan) ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2010) Ivan Mihaljević and Side Effects je progressive rock senzacija iz Zagreba. Nakon prvog albuma Sandcastle koji je izmamio laskave kritike stranih novinara te nakon nastupa s mnogim svjetskim gitarističkim zvijezdama kao što su Paul Gilbert, Les Paul i Richie Kotzen, dečki su snimili drugi album naslova Destination Unknown. Priča je počela kao samostalni projekt gitarista Ivana Mihaljevića Mihe (koji je gitarist grupe Hard Time) koji je sam snimio prvi album Sandcastle, a potom su mu se pridružili ostali članovi kako bi mogao taj materijal izvoditi uživo. Nakon godinu dana suradnje benda u kojem svi članovi sudjeluju u kreativnom procesu, snimljen je album Destination Unknown. Uz Mihu u ulozi gitarista i vokala, ostali članovi su Majkl Jagunić na bas-gitari i Alen Frljak na bubnjevima. Grupa Gang Bang je autorski band rock usmjerenja s primjesama bluesa i progressive. Grupa nastaje 2004. godine, a u ovom sastavu djeluje od 2007. Do 2009. godine Gang Bang na HRT-u snima 11 demopjesama, a pjesmu Egocentric Blues producira Bahrija Golubović. Tada je u studiju Bajsić na Prisavlju snimljen i jedan od značajnijih uradaka uživo. Tada se formira skupina u sastavu: Ivan Pelivanović - Pele (gitara), Filip Fabijanić (vokal), Nikola Kufrin (klavijature), Karlo Kurtalj (bas-gitara) i Filip Borovec (bubnjevi) u kojem Ivan Pelivanović preuzima glavnu autorsku ulogu budući da je već imao dobrih rezultata u pisanju kazališne glazbe (županijska nagrada za najbolju kazališnu glazbu 2007. za predstavu Petar Pan)...
