programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) This is the first broadcast of four of them, which is being covered by the multi -day program of the sixth edition of the Euphonie Festival in Warsaw, the Festival of Central European and Eastern European Music, which took place this year under the theme "Jeke and Srection". It brings a review of a magnificent concert performance of a summer opera star, the world's largest mezzo -soprano Elina Garanče, with the Orchestra of the Great Theater of the Polish National Opera and under the leadership of her life and professional partner Karel Marko Chichon. The "Opera Gala" concert in November 15 was held and, among other things, performed the rarity aria of Carmen, which Bizet originally wrote for his heroine, but the singers declared it impossible for her and replaced her with a famous Habaner. Although she is talked about in an interview with Garanca, we could not record her for banning her publisher. That is why, with the interviews, we housed her first performance of Julia's lullaby from the 3rd act of Dvořák's Opera "Jakobinac" op. 84 from 1888, with which she opened a spectacular concert, respecting the geographical framework of the festival. After the concert, the singer and conductor shared autographs in the foyer of the halls late into the night and took pictures with fans who were patiently waiting in an endless order. At the same time, it was an occasion for exclusively for Croatian television to announce their recent arrival in Zagreb on February 10, 2025, when they would perform in the "Best of Elina Garanca" program at the Lisinski Concert Hall, which they both look forward to because the previous two concerts in that hall, at the invitation of its former director Drazen Siriščević. Many of his participants in the auditorium are discussed about the Euphonie Festival and the Euphonie Festival: Olga Wysock, Director of the National Institute Adam Mickiewicz, in charge of promoting Polish art abroad; King Wojciechowska, owner and editor -in -chief of magazine and portal dedicated to music and art, Presto Publish, Mediac ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovo je prva emisija u nizu od četiri, koliko ih obrađuje višednevni program šestog izdanja Festivala Eufonie u Varšavi, festivala srednjoeuropske i istočnoeuropske glazbe, koji se ove godine odvio pod temom "Jeke i odzvanjanja". Donosi osvrt na veličanstven koncertni nastup letonske operne zvijezde, najveće svjetske mezzosopranistice Eline Garanče, uz Orkestar Velikog kazališta Poljske narodne opere i pod vodstvom njezina životnog i profesionalnog partnera Karela Marka Chichona. "Opera gala" koncert u održan je 15. studenog i na njemu su, među ostalim, izveli raritetnu ariju Carmen koju je Bizet izvorno napisao za svoju junakinju, ali su je pjevačice njegova doba proglasile neizvedivom pa ju je zamijenio poznatom habanerom. Premda se o njoj govori u intervjuu s Garančom, nismo je mogli snimiti zbog zabrane njezina izdavača. Zato smo uz intervjue smjestili njezinu prvu izvedbu Julijine uspavanke iz 3. čina Dvořákove opere "Jakobinac" op. 84. iz 1888., s kojim je otvorila spektakularni koncert, poštujući zemljopisni okvir festivala. Nakon koncerta, pjevačica i dirigent su u foajeu dvorane do kasno u noć dijelili autograme i fotografirali se s obožavateljima koji su strpljivo čekali u beskonačnom redu. Ujedno, bila je to prigoda da ekskluzivno za Hrvatsku televiziju najave svoj skorašnji dolazak u Zagreb 10. veljače 2025., kada će nastupiti u programu "Best of Elina Garanča" u Koncertnoj dvorani Lisinski, čemu se oboje jako raduju jer su im prethodna dva koncerta u toj dvorani, na poziv njezina nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Dražena Siriščevića, ostala u lijepom sjećanju. O programu koncerta te općenito o Festivalu Eufonie govore mnogi njegovi sudionici koje smo susreli u auditoriju: Olga Wysocka, ravnateljica nacionanog Instituta Adam Mickiewicz, zaduženog za promociju poljske umjetnosti u inozemstvu; Kinga Wojciechowska, vlasnica i glavna urednica časopisa i portala posvećenog glazbi i umjetnosti Presto Publishing, medijsk...

programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2024) in the Old Town of Hvar every two years, days in Vali, the festival of ships, the sea and the sailors are held. In the Old Town, for the fifth time, the rich Croatian maritime heritage, as well as the worldwide, has been honored for the fifth time. This year the Honorary Land of the Partner was the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and representatives from Montenegro came. And they contributed to their wooden ships with a lavish celebration in the Old Town Wave. More than fifty wooden ships came to the Old Town from all parts of Croatia. Friends and guests of the festival enjoyed the view of traditional passages, the Falkusa, the gait, but also the river boats, because representatives from Rugvica and the Neretva Heritage Association came to Opuzen. With music, ships and workshops, on days in Vali and gastronomy, she got a special part. Top chef Hrvoje Zirojevic presided over the jury on the waterfront, which evaluated the Dalmatian marenda. In addition to representatives from Komiža, Malinska, Murter, Vrboska, special guests from the City of Dubrovnik presented their maritime heritage of Karak. The organizers of the day in Vali are Cronaves, the Association for the Promotion of Croatian Maritime Heritage and the Old Town Tourist Board. R .: Tanja Kanceljak ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2024) U Starom Gradu na Hvaru svake se dvije godine održavaju Dani u vali, Festival brodova, mora i mornara. U Starom Gradu već se peti put odaje počast bogatoj hrvatskoj maritimnoj baštini, ali i svjetskoj. Ove je godine počasna zemlja partner bila Kraljevina Nizozemska, a došli su i predstavnici iz Crne Gore. I oni su svojim drvenim brodovima pridonijeli raskošnoj proslavi u starogradskoj vali. U Stari Grad došlo je više od pedeset drvenih brodova iz svih dijelova Hrvatske. Prijatelji i gosti Festivala uživali su u pogledu na tradicijske pasare, falkuše, gajete, ali i riječne lađe jer su u Stari Grad došli i predstavnici iz Rugvice te udruge Baština Neretve iz Opuzena. Uz glazbu, brodove i radionice, na Danima u vali i gastronomija je dobila poseban dio. Vrhunski kuhar Hrvoje Zirojević na rivi je predsjedao žirijem koji je ocjenjivao dalmatinske marende. Uz predstavnike iz Komiže, Malinske, Murtera, Vrboske, svoju maritimnu baštinu brodom Karaka predstavili su i posebni gosti iz Grada Dubrovnika. Organizatori Dana u vali su Cronaves, udruga za promicanje hrvatske maritimne baštine te Turistička zajednica Staroga Grada. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolković - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, physician psychiatrist, professor emeritus at the University of Zagreb, subspecialist of biological psychiatry and social psychiatry. We discuss with Professor Jakovljevic about the definition of the health and culture of the soul, the health of the well -being and satisfaction of our needs, the components of health, the salutogenesis, the construction of healthy society and empathy civilization, about toxic cultures and a sense of security, and paranoid culture, radicalization and manic, narcissistic culture in which we live and the transgenerational culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and transgend Traumas, about depressed culture and a healthy individual in a toxic society, on the foam attacks on citizens around the world and in us, cult of happiness, false and authentic happiness, about the anomity of our society and the democratic right to be a fool, about Rifkin's concept of a race for global consciousness, what is the basis of Western civilizations. Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, Professor Emeritus, was the head of the Clinic for Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Zagreb at KBC Zagreb from 2007 to 2015, Head of the Department of Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2000 to 2013 and Vice -Dean of Science, Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2007. He has published 20 books, more than 28 chapters in the books of other authors and more than 200 scientific and professional papers. He was a leader and chief researcher in numerous national and international clinical research. The invited lecturer at numerous national, international and world congresses. The most mentioned is a psychiatrist in the region and is located on the Stanford list of 2% of distinguished world scientists in Croatia. He is the editor -in -chief of the magazine "Psychiatria Danubina" and the magazine "Medicine Academica Integrative". R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, liječnik psihijatar, professor emeritus na Sveučilištu u Zagrebu, subspecijalist biologijske psihijatrije i socijalne psihijatrije. S profesorom Jakovljevićem razgovaramo o definiciji zdravlja i kulturi duše, o zdravlju kao blagostanju i zadovoljavanju naših potreba, o komponentama zdravlja, o salutogenezi, o izgradnji zdravog društva i empatijske civilizacije, o toksičnim kulturama i osjećaju sigurnosti te paranoidnoj kulturi, o radikalizaciji i maničnoj, narcističkoj kulturi u kojoj živimo te o transgeneracijskim traumama, o depresivnoj kulturi i zdravom pojedincu u toksičnom društvu, o sumanutim napadima na građane diljem svijeta i u nas, kultu sreće, lažnoj i autentičnoj sreći, o anomičnosti našeg društva i demokratskom pravu da se bude budala, o Rifkinovom konceptu utrke za globalnom sviješću, o tome što je temelj zapadne civilizacije empatije te o sukobu civilizacija. Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, professor emeritus, bio je predstojnik Klinike za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu u KBC Zagreb od 2007. do 2015., pročelnik Katedre za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2000. do 2013. te prodekan za znanost Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2007. do 2013. godine. Objavio je 20 knjiga, više od 28 poglavlja u knjigama drugih autora te više od 200 znanstvenih i stručnih radova. Bio je voditelj i glavni istraživač u brojnim nacionalnim i internacionalnim kliničkim istraživanjima. Pozvani predavač na brojnim nacionalnim, internacionalnim i svjetskim kongresima. Najcitiraniji je psihijatar u regiji i nalazi se na Stanford listi 2% uglednih svjetskih znanstvenika u Hrvatskoj. Glavni je urednik časopisa "Psychiatria Danubina" i časopisa "Medicina Academica Integrativa". R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where fate leads two friends close to marriage to the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Dunk / Dunk
programme.desc: The series revolves around a university, where the student Amal accuses her professor of harassing her, thus receiving support from all around her, but we discover that all of this is part of a plan that the student has orphaned to save her fiancé from great trouble. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إحدى الجامعات، حيث تتهم الطالبة أمل أستاذها بالتحرش بها وبذلك تلقى الدعم من جميع من حولها، ولكن نكتشف أن كل هذا هو جزء من خطة قد دبرتها الطالبة لإنقاذ خطيبها من ورطة كبيرة.

programme.title: My dear father / والدي العزيز
programme.desc: A failed love story ends with the separation of a man and a woman and their departure from each other, but when they meet again after many years, this love story returns to open its doors again. / تنتهي قصة حب فاشلة بانفصال رجل وامرأة وابتعادهما عن بعضهما البعض، ولكن حينما يتقابلان من جديد بعد سنوات عديدة، تعود قصة الحب تلك لتفتح أبوابها من جديد.

programme.title: Layalina 80 / ليالينا ٨٠
programme.desc: The events revolve around the eighties of Hisham's life, who returns from work in the Gulf and his life changes after a car accident that his beautiful daughter is exposed to the driver, Radi, and begins to notice what he does not know about his wife, Maryam. / تدور الأحداث في الثمانينات حول حياة هشام، الذي يعود من العمل بالخليج وتتغير حياته بعد حادث سيارة تتعرض له ابنته جميلة مع السائق راضي، ويبدأ في ملاحظة ما لا يعلمه عن زوجته مريم.

programme.title: Nun Al -Niswa / نون النسوة
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events of the series gathered five friends, gathering the paths of life, and their problems and dreams spread, and each of them tries to support the other until they reach safety after a group of disappointments that struck them. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي تجمع أحداث المسلسل خمس صديقات، تجمعهن دروب الحياة، فيتشاركن مشاكلهن، وأحلامهن، وتحاول كلا منهن مساندة الأخرى حتى يصلن إلى بر الأمان بعد مجموعة خيبات ضربت بهن.

programme.title: Persia without permissibility / فارس بلا جواز
programme.desc: Through separate connected episodes, the series revolves when Faris is exposed to some circumstances outside his Jordanian, which compels him to search for a bride. / من خلال حلقات متصلة منفصلة، تدور أحداث المسلسل عندما يتعرض فارس لبعض الظروف الخارجة عن إرداته، والتي تجبره للبحث عن عروس.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: peacock / الطاووس
programme.desc: Kamal the fleet is a veteran lawyer interested in compensation cases, but the conditions compel him to investigate one of the rape cases that turn his life upside down. / كمال الأسطول محامي مخضرم مهتم بقضايا التعويضات، ولكن الظروف تضطره كي يحقق في إحدى قضايا اﻻغتصاب التي تقلب حياته رأسا على عقب.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.desc: Maria Emilio Sandro, who has lived throughout her life in the Shubra neighborhood, decided to tell the ears of her grandson's story in the neighborhood, the stormy crises she was exposed to, and the story of her love with Karim Al -Masry, which changed her life entirely. / تقرر ماريا إميليو ساندرو التي عاشت طيلة حياتها في حي شبرا أن تسرد على مسامع حفيدها قصة حياتها في الحي، واﻷزمات العاصفة التي تعرضت لها، وقصة حبها مع كريم المصري التي غيرت حياتها كلية.

programme.title: Lane / الحارة
programme.desc: The events take place in an Egyptian lane, through a pivotal figure (Mina) who works to spend on her poor family, and the personalities in the neighborhood vary among the people of the neighborhood who adhere to the principles and morals they were brought up with, and between some who come out on these customs and traditions. / تدور الأحداث في حارة مصرية، من خلال شخصية محورية هي (منى) التي تعمل للإنفاق على أسرتها الفقيرة، و تتنوع الشخصيات في الحارة بين أهالي الحارة الذين يتمسكون بمباديء وأخلاق تربوا عليها، وبين البعض الذي يخرج على هذه العادات والتقاليد.

programme.title: Girls x girls / بنات x بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves in a comic framework through separate, connected episodes that deal with many ideas that discuss women's problems in Egyptian society, where Magda, who is practiced in each episode of a different profession. / يدور المسلسل في إطار كوميدي من خلال حلقات منفصلة متصلة تتناول العديد من الأفكار التى تناقش مشاكل المرأة فى المجتمع المصرى حيث ماجدة التي تمتهن في كل حلقة مهنة مختلفة.

programme.title: Call count / عد تنازلي
programme.desc: The series revolves around a social police form on Salim (Amr Youssef), and his wife (Kinda Alloush), who live in a stable ordinary life, but the events turn, conditions overlap, and (Selim) is forced to commit many crimes, so Lieutenant Colonel Hamza (Tariq Lotfi) takes over the investigation of the matter, and revealed the circumstances of the crimes. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في قالب بوليسي اجتماعي عن سليم (عمرو يوسف) ، وزوجته (كندة علوش) اللذين يعيشان حياة عادية مستقرة ، ولكن تنقلب الأحداث ، وتتداخل الظروف ، ويضطر (سليم) لارتكاب العديد من الجرائم ، فيتولى المقدم حمزة (طارق لطفي) التحقيق في الأمر ، وكشف ملابسات الجرائم .

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.desc: The story revolves around the Egyptian seas (Mandi), who is in love with (Zaghdana) strongly, Zagdana is being raped by the English soldiers, Mandi gets angry with this heinous incident and decides to take revenge on the English soldiers occupied his country and the aggressors. / تدور أحداث القصة حول البحار المصري (مُندي) الذي يقع في حب (زغدانة) بشدة، تتعرض زغدانة للاغتصاب من الجنود الإنجليز، يغضب مُندي من هذه الحادثة الشنيعة ويقرر الانتقام من الجنود الإنجليز المحتلين لبلاده والمعتدين على عرضه.

programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. programme.title: Our countryside / Náš venkov
programme.desc: For more than ten years, Mr. Valter Brod has been carrying people with a carriage. He is known to many newlyweds who have dreamed of a fairy -tale ride for their day D. As a coachman, he has the most work in the years. In addition to regular rides, they run for free with the elderly in the chamber Lhotka, or with affected children in Třinec. "There I take the most for my way so I don't have to pay for retirement. I take them into the countryside, to the forests. The joy they experience will make up for all cash rewards." Valter Brod has supported in his wife. Together, they took a little girl to the foster bake years ago, although they already had three of their own daughters at home. "There was such a service that people could take children from children's homes for a weekend or Christmas, and they were returning to the facility again. We wanted to help, but we didn't like the form. That they would be with us and then go back. So we decided to take it permanently." Now that all daughters are adult and self -sufficient, Brod takes care of the girl from Tanzania remotely. "Life makes sense when ... / Víc než deset let vozí pan Valter Broda lidi kočárem. Znají ho mnozí novomanžele, kteří si pro svůj den D vysnili pohádkovou jízdu. Jako kočí má nejvíc práce v období leta. Kromě běžných jízd jezdí zadarmo se seniory v Komorní Lhotce, nebo s postiženými dětmi v Třinci. "Tam si beru maximálně za cestu, abych to nemusel doplácet z důchodu. Zavezu je do přírody, do lesů. Ta radost, kterou prožívají, vynahradí veškere peněžní odměny." Valter Broda má oporu ve sve manželce. Společně si před lety navíc vzali do pěstounske peče holčičku, ačkoliv již měli doma tři vlastní dcery. "Byla tehdy taková služba, že si lide mohli na víkend nebo na Vánoce brát děti z dětských domovů a ty se pak do zařízení zase vracely. Chtěli jsme pomoci, ale nelíbila se nám ta forma. Že budou pár dní s námi a pak se zase vrátí zpět. Tak jsme se rozhodli vzít si ji natrvalo." Teď, když jsou všechny dcery dospěle a soběstačne, se zase Brodovi na dálku starají o dívku z Tanzanie. programme.title: The candy of the world / Bonbonky světa
programme.desc: Cuba is the largest island state of the Caribbean, which is adjacent to the United States and Mexico across the sea. It is traditionally a Catholic country, with no considerable influence of Afrokuban Santeria, a religion based on the cults of West African ethnicity of Yorub. Together with the traveler Petr Horký, we will witness the initiation ritual in which the traveler will be accepted into this cult. In the capital of the island of Havana, we will have the opportunity to watch everyday military exercises in which residents with mock -ups in hand are preparing to attack American troops. Nicmane, like a number of other everyday events in Cuba, the military exercise ends with a carnival street celebration in the rhythm of live music. Petr Horký and I will also visit the local bars, where the lemonade is significantly more expensive than the rum, which has become the most popular drink. We will end the visit of Cuba truly explosive - a celebration of Christmas Day, which takes place here after the home -made fireworks. / Kuba je největší ostrovní stát Karibiku, který přes moře sousedí se Spojenými státy a Mexikem. Je tradičně katolickou zemí, nicmeně se značným vlivem afrokubánske santerie, tedy náboženství vycházejícího z kultů západoafrickeho etnika Yoruba. Spolu s cestovatelem Petrem Horkým budeme svědky iniciačního rituálu, při kterem bude cestovatel do tohoto kultu přijat. V hlavním městě ostrova Havaně budeme mít možnost sledovat každodenní vojenske cvičení, při kterem se obyvatele s maketami samopalů v ruce připravují na útok amerických vojsk. Nicmeně stejně jako řada dalších každodenních událostí na Kubě, je i vojenske cvičení zakončeno karnevalovou pouliční oslavou v rytmu žive hudby. S Petrem Horkým zavítáme take do místních barů, kde je limonáda výrazně dražší než rum, který se tím pádem stal nejpopulárnějším nápojem. Návštěvu Kuby zakončíme vskutku výbušně – oslavou Štědreho dne, která se zde odehrává ve znamení po domácku vyrobených ohňostrojů.

Doch nach dem Scheitern der Regierungsverhandlungen mit der ÖVP bleibt der Chef der mittlerweile starksten Parlamentspartei in Opposition. Wie geht Herbert Kickl personlich mit dieser Wendung um? programme.title: Urban Pulse - the heartbeat of a city / Urban Pulse - Der Herzschlag einer Stadt
programme.desc: Since 1979, the Linz sound cloud has been beating as a pulsating heart of cultural innovation and artistic freedom. What started as an open-air event has developed into an urban spectacle that transforms the city of Linz into a living sound room and opened new perceptions. The 2025 edition, "Urban Pulse", immerses in the heartbeat of the city - in funfi -powerful pictures it sprints the rhythm of Linz: from industrial energy over river and nature to the Nibelungenbrucke, which becomes a symbol of the city a pulsating organism. Composer Johannes Berauer transforms this pulse into a powerful orchestral work that can bring the Bruckner Orchestra Linz to life. Percussionist Christoph Sietzen with his Motus Ensemble drains through a dynamic sound landscape, while director Simon Eichenberger visual spectacle made of fire, water, shadow figures and a container town on the Danube. Electronic music, live orchestra, sound installations ... / Seit 1979 schlagt die Linzer Klangwolke als pulsierendes Herz kultureller Innovation und kunstlerischer Freiheit. Was als Freiluft-Event begann, hat sich zu einem urbanen Spektakel entwickelt, das die Stadt Linz in einen lebendigen Klangraum verwandelt und neue Wahrnehmungen offnet. Die Ausgabe 2025, "URBAN PULSE", taucht ein in den Herzschlag der Stadt - in funf kraftvollen Bildern spurt sie den Rhythmus Linz nach: von industrieller Energie uber Fluss und Natur bis zur Nibelungenbrucke, die als Symbol der Stadt zum pulsierenden Organismus wird. Komponist Johannes Berauer verwandelt diesen Puls in ein kraftvolles Orchesterwerk, das das Bruckner Orchester Linz lebendig werden lasst. Percussionist Christoph Sietzen mit seinem MOTUS Ensemble fuhrt durch eine dynamische Klanglandschaft, wahrend Regisseur Simon Eichenberger visuelle Spektakel aus Feuer, Wasser, Schattenfiguren und einer Containerstadt auf der Donau inszeniert. Elektronische Musik, Live-Orchester, Klanginstallationen...

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: E1205 Alois Meininger, a convicted murder, is released from security custody after over 30 years, commits another murder and dives. Nobody can provide evidence where he could stay - the last hope lies on his former therapist Norbert Prinz, who is now demented. But how can you hear a dementia patient? In cooperation with the renowned neuropsychologist Prof. Vontheiden, a criminological pilot project is started: the practice room at that time is to resurrect again as a backdrop and the demented tribies are to be rejected. The commissioners hope to be able to elicit valuable information to him. However, in the course of the experiment, Batic and Leitmayr reveal themselves deeper rounds than first accepted. / E1205 Alois Meininger, ein verurteilter Morder, wird nach uber 30 Jahren aus der Sicherheitsverwahrung entlassen, begeht einen weiteren Mord und taucht unter. Niemand kann Indizien liefern, wo er sich aufhalten konnte - die letzte Hoffnung liegt auf seinem ehemaligen Therapeuten Norbert Prinz, der inzwischen jedoch dement ist. Doch wie kann man einen Demenzkranken vernehmen? In Zusammenarbeit mit dem renommierten Neuropsychologen Prof. Vonderheiden wird ein kriminologisches Pilotprojekt gestartet: Der damalige Praxisraum soll als Kulisse wieder auferstehen und der demente Proband hineingefuhrt werden. Die Kommissare hoffen, ihm so wertvolle Hinweise entlocken zu konnen. Doch im Laufe des Experiments offenbaren sich Batic und Leitmayr tiefere Abgrunde als zunachst angenommen.

programme.title: Love shifts and marriage matters / Liebesgschichten und Heiratssachen
programme.desc: S29E09 For the ninth time this summer, Nina Horowitz Amor helps on the Sprunge: Gerda from Lower East might give away, love and loved her heart, Rudolf from Styria is looking for a loyal friend for beautiful hours and Rosi from the Sudburgenland hopes for the dream prince, where it crackles again. Harald from Vienna might meet a woman with whom you can steal horses, Marianne from Niederosterreich might fall in love and Peter from Oberosterreich believes "the right one", for whom he is ready to give everything. / S29E09 Zum neunten Mal in diesem Sommer hilft Nina Horowitz Amor auf die Sprunge: Gerda aus Niederosterreich mochte ihr Herz verschenken, lieben und geliebt werden, Rudolf aus der Steiermark sucht eine treue Freundin fur schone Stunden und Rosi aus dem Sudburgenland hofft auf den Traumprinzen, bei dem es wieder knistert. Harald aus Wien mochte eine Frau treffen, mit der man Pferde stehlen kann, Marianne aus Niederosterreich mochte sich neu verlieben und Peter aus Oberosterreich glaubt an "Die Richtige", fur die er bereit ist, alles zu geben.

programme.desc: Martin Ferdiny Prasy "Studio 2" on Monday, September 8th, at 5:30 p.m. in ORF 2 with u. Current: 60 years ago the association "Help in their own country, disaster aid Austria" was founded. The association supports people who are in tragic situations through no fault of their own - be it through personal fate or natural disasters. In the previous year, these were especially people who were affected by the flood in Lower Easter Empire. Prasident Sissi Proll is live in the studio. Animals of the week: Every Monday "Studio 2" reports Uber animal keepers who are looking for a new home. This time it is about the two -year dwarf dog "Lucy", who has arrived completely neglected in the Vosendorf animal shelter and is now hoping for a new home. Veterinary consultation: In conversation with a veterinarian ... / Martin Ferdiny prasentiert "Studio 2" am Montag, dem 8. September, um 17.30 Uhr in ORF 2 mit u. a. folgenden Themen: Anna Depenbusch zu Gast im Studio: Liedermacherin Anna Depenbusch gibt im Oktober ein Konzert im Theater Akzent. Mehr daruber erzahlt sie in "Studio 2". Aktuell: Vor 60 Jahren wurde der Verein "Hilfe im eigenen Land, Katastrophenhilfe Österreich" gegrundet. Der Verein unterstutzt Menschen, die unverschuldet in tragische Lebenslagen geraten sind – sei es durch personliche Schicksalsschlage oder Naturkatastrophen. programme.title: Deliberately healthy - the magazine / Bewusst gesund - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Erectile dysfunction - therapies against impotence: erectile dysfunction is still a taboo subject - although 40 percent of men at the age of 40 are affected and the number increases by a further ten percent every ten years. The most common cause for impotence is a combination of age, high blood pressure and a disease such as diabetes. However, the stoors can also be a warning signal for other diseases or psychological problems. In addition to medication in many traps, blank therapy and hypnosis can also help. Design: Larissa Putz Studio discussion: Age medicine of the future: The health system presents an ever -getting -getting -to -be population with great challenges. New technologies are in demand. In geriatrics, these with many digital applications and highly sensitive sensors already show promising effects on physical, cognitive and emotional health of elderly people. Also in dementia pravention are directional ... / Erektile Dysfunktion – Therapien gegen Impotenz: Erektile Dysfunktion ist nach wie vor ein Tabuthema – obwohl 40 Prozent der Manner im Alter von 40 Jahren betroffen sind und die Anzahl alle zehn Jahre um weitere zehn Prozent steigt. Die haufigste Ursache fur Impotenz ist eine Kombination aus Alter, Bluthochdruck und einer Erkrankung wie Diabetes. Die Storung kann aber auch ein Warnsignal fur andere Krankheiten oder psychische Probleme sein. Neben Medikamenten konnen in vielen Fallen auch StoSSwellentherapie und Hypnose helfen. Gestaltung: Larissa Putz Studiogesprach: Altersmedizin der Zukunft: Eine immer alter werdende Bevolkerung stellt das Gesundheitssystem vor groSSe Herausforderungen. Neue Technologien sind gefragt. In der Geriatrie zeigen diese mit vielen digitalen Anwendungen und hochsensiblen Sensoren bereits vielversprechende Effekte auf die physische, kognitive und emotionale Gesundheit betagter Menschen. Auch in der Demenzpravention zeichnen sich richtungsweisende...

programme.title: Viennese utopias / Wiener Utopien
programme.desc: The "Vienna Utopia" enables a look in the past as well as 100 years into the future. The "unobstructed city" of the past - visualized by digital models - serves as a means to make social current and power conditions visible. For the future, students of the university are developing for applied art strategies in order to practically address the urgent problems of big city. Selected examples make it clear how and where the city could fundamentally agree and how to meet the future in Vienna. A film by Judith Doppler for the Vienna State Studio / Die "Wiener Utopien" ermoglichen einen Blick sowohl 100 Jahre in die Vergangenheit als auch 100 Jahre in die Zukunft. Die "ungebaute Stadt" der Vergangenheit - visualisiert durch digitale Modelle - dient dabei als Mittel, um gesellschaftliche Stromungen und Machtverhaltnisse sichtbar zu machen. Fur die Zukunft entwickeln Studierende der Universitat fur angewandte Kunst Strategien um die drangenden Probleme groSSer Stadte praktisch anzugehen. Anhand ausgewahlter Beispiele wird verdeutlicht, wie und wo sich die Stadt grundlegend hatte verandern konnen und wie man in Wien der Zukunft begegnen will. Ein Film von Judith Doppler fur das Landesstudio Wien

programme.title: 9 Breaks - 9 Schatze: So is Austria / 9 Platze - 9 Schatze: So schon ist Österreich
programme.desc: E09 Vienna shows itself from its earliest side - on a ride with one of the legendary Fiaker, we show idyllic and exciting places across the city from downtown: we visit the museum quarters and the Secession, the Naschmarkt and the House of the Sea, the elevated zoo and the palm house in Schonbrunn, make a detour to the breathtaking church at the Steinhof and naturally. Accompanied by Elisabeth Vogel we drive along the Danube Canal and end our trip to the central cemetery. / E09 Wien zeigt sich von seiner schonsten Seite - auf einer Fahrt mit einem der legendaren Fiaker zeigen wir ausgehend von der Innenstadt idyllische und aufregende Platze quer durch die Stadt: wir besuchen das Museumsquartier und die Secession, den Naschmarkt und das Haus des Meeres, den beruhmten Tiergarten und das Palmenhaus in Schonbrunn, machen einen Abstecher in die atemberaubend schone Kirche am Steinhof und naturlich in den Wurstelprater. Begleitet von Elisabeth Vogel fahren wir am Donaukanal entlang und beenden unseren Ausflug am Zentralfriedhof.

programme.desc: E03 After the deprivation -rich post -war period, Austria experienced a great economic upswing from the 1950s. The industry is booming and the need for work can hardly be covered - for this reason, Austria decides to actively recruit work forces. From the 1960s, hundreds of thousands of migrants come to Austria through the recruitment agreements in order to understood the Easter Reiche economy with their workforce. The so -called "guest workers" contribute significantly to the enormous wealth of prosperity of this time - and drove to a new, diverse more Esterreichic identity, which is also reflected in culinary delights. Today Kebap and Bosna remain the most popular "delicacies" that you can buy on any street corner. The new ORF III series "The Austrians and their roots" embarks on the traces of the colorful history of origin of the Austrians. / E03 Nach der entbehrungsreichen Nachkriegszeit erfahrt Österreich ab den 1950ern einen groSSen wirtschaftlichen Aufschwung. Die Industrie boomt und der Arbeitskraftebedarf kann kaum gedeckt werden - aus diesem Grund beschlieSSt Österreich, Arbeitskrafte aktiv anzuwerben. Durch die Anwerbeabkommen kommen ab den 1960ern hunderttausende Migranten nach Österreich um mit ihrer Arbeitskraft die osterreichische Wirtschaft zu unterstutzen. Die sogenannten "Gastarbeiter" tragen erheblich zum enormen Wohlstandsgewinn dieser Zeit bei - und fuhren zu einer neuen, vielfaltigeren osterreichischen Identitat die sich auch kulinarisch niederschlagt. Heute gehoren Kebap und Bosna zu den beliebtesten "Schmankerln" die man an jeder StraSSenecke kaufen kann. programme.desc: "Land of the Mountains" is on the road around the mountain range of the Hochking in the Berchtesgaden Alps. The UNESCO GEOPARK "Erz der Berge" is closely linked to this, the focus of which is located on mining use in the Salzburger Pongau in the municipalities of Bischofshofen, Muhlbach am Hochkonig, Huttau and Sankt Veit im Pongau. The degradation of the copper can be traced here until the Bronze Age and reached the mid -1970s. "Land of the Mountains" offers a unique insight into the modern and prahoric mining history of the region and shows a landscape framed by bizarre rock formations, roaring water traps, as well as wonderful viewpoints to the Tennengebirge, to Radstadt and the Hohen Tauern. (Doku 2019) / "Land der Berge" ist dieses Mal unterwegs rund um das Gebirgsmassiv des Hochkonigs in den Berchtesgadener Alpen. Eng damit verbunden ist der UNESCO Geopark "Erz der Berge", dessen inhaltlicher Schwerpunkt auf die bergbauliche Nutzung im Salzburger Pongau in den Gemeinden Bischofshofen, Muhlbach am Hochkonig, Huttau und Sankt Veit im Pongau liegt. Der Abbau des Kupfers lasst sich hier bis in die Bronzezeit zuruckverfolgen und reichte bis in die Mitte der 1970er Jahre. "Land der Berge" bietet einen einzigartigen Einblick in die neuzeitlichen und prahistorische Bergbaugeschichte der Region und zeigt eine Landschaft umrahmt von bizarren Felsformationen, tosenden Wasserfalle, sowie von herrlichen Aussichtspunkten ins Tennengebirge, nach Radstadt und die Hohen Tauern. programme.title: Hockey (M): Bern - Comet Brno, Champions League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Bern - Kometa Brno, Liga prvakov 2025/2026
programme.desc: Champions Hockey League is the most important European Cup of ice hockey competition. Since the 2017/18 season, only 32 teams have been involved. These are initially divided into eight groups of four teams. The two best teams from each group qualify for the eighth finals. From here on, it is played according to a home and return game system.
